channel.title: Risk alerts: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New risk alerts filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Hyungji I&C filed for an injunction in Seoul Southern District Court to suspend Korea Exchange's delisting and administrative issue designation decisions.
Sambu Construction discloses improvement plan after being granted an improvement period until 13 November 2027 in its listing eligibility review.
Automobile & PCB applied to Seoul Southern District Court to suspend its delisting decision and administrative issue designations by Korea Exchange.
Bumyang Construction's sub-KRW 500 million quarterly revenue will not trigger a listing eligibility review because delisting was already decided on 21 September 2026.
KRX warns KleanNara Class 1 preferred shares face delisting risk after failing the KRW 2bn market capitalization requirement
Korea Exchange will decide by December 4, 2026 whether Copus Korea is subject to a substantive listing eligibility review.
Itoxi's quarterly report shows revenue below KRW 300 million for the latest quarter, adding a ground for KOSDAQ listing eligibility review.
Celestra's Q3 revenue fell below KRW 300 million, an added listing eligibility review ground, but procedures are on hold pending litigation.
Itoxi filed an objection on Nov 16, 2026 to the Corporate Review Committee's Oct 26 decision to delist its shares.
Sejin T.S filed a court petition to suspend the Korea Exchange's 23 September 2026 delisting decision and block liquidation trading.
Cellumed's board decided a 22.54% differential capital reduction, cancelling 18,761,339 common shares held by its largest shareholder, TD Landmark Partnership No. 1.
Aptn's board decided on a 90.00% free capital reduction via a 10-to-1 reverse split of common shares to offset accumulated deficit.
SG Global warned its common stock may be designated an administrative issue after closing below KRW 1,000 for 25 consecutive trading days.
Pyeong Hwa Industry warned its common shares may be designated an administrative issue after 25 consecutive trading days closing below KRW 1,000.
Korea Exchange warns Hansol HomeDeco common stock may be designated an administrative issue as market cap stayed below KRW 30bn for 25 trading days.
Korea Exchange warns Woojin INS common shares may be designated administrative issue after market cap stayed below KRW 30bn for 25 trading days.
JR Global REIT amended its filing: Seoul Rehabilitation Court extended the ARS deferral of its rehabilitation commencement decision to December 13, 2026.
Cellumed amends its capital reduction plan, increasing the cancelled shares of its largest shareholder to 19,000,000 and postponing the schedule.
Samyoung E&C amended its capital reduction filing, revising share counts and post-reduction capital after fractional share treatment; the reduction ratio is 75%.
WISCOM warned its common shares may be designated an administrative issue after market cap stayed below KRW 30bn for 25 trading days.
Qade disclosed its improvement plan after the KOSDAQ Market Committee granted a nine-month improvement period on Nov 11, 2026.
KRX warns Dongyang 2nd Preferred Shares (new) face delisting if market cap stays below KRW 2.0bn for 61 days.
KOSDAQ notes Ollipass's latest quarterly revenue is below KRW 300 million, an added review ground, but procedures stay on hold pending litigation.
Korea Steel Wire's shares were halted on Nov 6, 2026 at 15:14 over a bonus issue of 10% or more, resuming Nov 9.
KOSDAQ halted trading in Pino common shares on 2026-11-05 to determine whether a backdoor listing applies and requirements are met.
